original.target_description: Experiment 2: online missing-vertex localization task; outcome/test unresolved among coordinate bias and standard-deviation scaling results.

notes: Identity verified from supplied canonical text: title The statistical shape of geometric reasoning; authors Yuval Hart, Moira R. Dillon, Andrew Marantan, Anna L. Cardenas, Elizabeth Spelke, L. Mahadevan; Scientific Reports (2018) 8:12906; DOI 10.1038/s41598-018-30314-y. The candidate is a 12-page primary research article PDF text extraction, including Results and Materials and Methods, rather than an abstract or secondary summary. No PDF path is supplied, and the Supplementary Information cited for Experiment 2 (Fig. S4) is not included. Study identifier 2 supports Experiment 2, but the generic title-only description and empty original locator do not distinguish y-coordinate localization bias, y-coordinate standard-deviation scaling, x-coordinate directional bias, or x-coordinate standard-deviation scaling. No target selected from row order or numeric agreement. Candidate evidence: pp. 2–3 report N = 100 and y-coordinate standard-deviation scaling σ ∼ L0.65 (a power-law exponent, not Cohen d); x-coordinate findings are also reported. Methods p. 9 gives two task groups of 50 participants each. Candidate arithmetic: 50 + 50 = 100 participants, not trials/observations; the groups differ in base angles and screen scale, and group 2 estimates are rescaled by 13/9. The source does not document exclusions or an independently identified target-test analytic sample. The candidate group total is retained only for parent field-scope review, not entered as verified analytic n. No d conversion was performed. No p was assigned from another experiment or from the descriptive scaling finding. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
